title: Home fire escape plan worksheet
dek: A free, printable worksheet for two ways out of every room, a meeting place, who helps whom, alarm dates and practice. It runs in your browser, keeps nothing, and works without JavaScript.
description: A free printable home fire escape worksheet based on USFA and NFPA: two exits per room, meeting place, helpers, alarm and practice dates. Private; nothing is saved.
recheck: If USFA or NFPA revise their escape-planning pages, or at the next quarterly source sweep.

source_use.usfa-fire-escape: Two ways out of every room; map with all doors and windows; outside meeting place in front; practice with everyone.
source_use.shelter-nfpa-escape: Helper and backup assignments; practice twice a year; escape-planning rules reflected in the worksheet's checks.
source_use.shelter-nfpa-smoke-alarms: Monthly alarm test; replace the unit 10 years after manufacture.
source_use.shelter-usfa-escape-grid: Fields of USFA's printable escape grid that the worksheet follows.
source_use.shelter-ready-home-fires: Practice in the dark; wake-up checks; simulation guidance context.
source_use.shelter-nfpa-high-rise: High-rise default: stairs; sealing in only when you cannot get out.
source_use.shelter-usfa-high-rise-handout: High-rise default: leave by the stairs; cannot-get-out steps.
